title: 探险大师
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_005, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "探险大师" (adventure master, somehow never pays). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a more heroic beveled gold rim and glossy teal enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, strapped to a tiny golden rocket backpack as if it is doing luxury adventure travel with someone else's budget. Suitcase and rocket backpack are the only main elements. Add two large star glints and a simple stylized flame shape as lighting/action, not a complex scene.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, silly heroic adventure, premium material finish, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: large readable silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, rocket backpack visible behind/below it, no background scene.
Lighting/mood: brighter heroic rim light, candy-like specular highlights, absurd luxury adventure comedy.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric teal enamel, coral-orange flame accent, black sunglasses, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no mountains, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
